div.div: 1. Every customer response has a predefined intent (not a numbered selection).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1058px; height: 1px; padding-top: 314px; margin-left: 12px;

div.div: 2. The wizard listens to the participant and clicks the matching intent in MATLAB.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1058px; height: 1px; padding-top: 434px; margin-left: 12px;

div.div: 3. Every waiter response is a prerecorded WAV clip with a stable ID.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1058px; height: 1px; padding-top: 554px; margin-left: 12px;

div.div: 4. Free-form wording can map to a fixed intent; unsupported replies trigger a fallback.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1058px; height: 1px; padding-top: 674px; margin-left: 12px;

div.div: 5. The same dialogue state can be revisited (e.g., ask about specials again).

div.div: 6. Replace [chosen dish] and [chosen drink] with concrete prerecorded combinations or record separate segments.
